snippet.title: Kabosu (Doge Meme) Life Timeline (2005–2024) | Then vs Now
snippet.description:
In this video, we follow the life timeline of Kabosu — the Japanese Shiba Inu who became the face of the legendary Doge meme.

Born around 2005, Kabosu was rescued from an animal shelter and adopted by kindergarten teacher Atsuko Sato in 2008.

In 2010, Atsuko shared the now-iconic photo of Kabosu looking sideways with her paws crossed. A few years later, the image spread across the internet and became one of the most recognizable memes of all time.

Kabosu’s unforgettable expression inspired millions of memes and later became the face of Dogecoin, turning an ordinary rescue dog into a worldwide internet icon.

Kabosu passed away peacefully on May 24, 2024, at the age of 18. Her image, story, and unique expression remain an important part of internet history.

From her early life and adoption to global meme fame and her final years, this timeline follows Kabosu’s journey from then to now.

snippet.title: Roll Safe Then vs Now: Kayode Ewumi (1993–2026) | Life Timeline
snippet.description:
In this video, we follow the life timeline of Kayode Ewumi - the British actor, writer, producer, comedian, and creator behind one of the most recognizable internet memes of all time.

Born in London in 1993, Kayode grew up in South London and developed an interest in acting and storytelling from a young age. After studying theatre at Coventry University, he graduated in 2015 and began creating his own comedy projects.

His breakthrough came with #HoodDocumentary, a viral mockumentary series co-created with Tyrell Williams. Kayode played Reece Simpson, better known as Roll Safe - an overconfident aspiring musician whose expressions, quotes, and unforgettable personality quickly attracted millions of viewers.

One particular moment, showing Roll Safe tapping his finger against his temple, later became the legendary “Think About It” meme. The image spread around the world and became one of the defining reaction memes of the internet era.

Following the success of #HoodDocumentary, BBC Three commissioned new episodes of the series. In 2016, Kayode was also selected as a BAFTA Breakthrough Brit, establishing him as one of Britain’s most promising young actor-writers.

But Kayode Ewumi’s career extends far beyond a single viral meme.

He later created, wrote, and starred in the BBC Three comedy-drama Enterprice, playing Kazim - an ambitious young entrepreneur trying to build a delivery company with his best friend. The series allowed Kayode to showcase his talent not only as a performer, but also as a television creator and writer.

Over the years, he continued developing original television and film projects, founded his own production company, Chatham Pictures, and built a career based on creativity, comedy, independence, and authentic storytelling.

From his childhood in South London and university years to #HoodDocumentary, worldwide meme fame, BAFTA recognition, Enterprice, and his work behind the camera, this timeline follows Kayode Ewumi through the years - showing his journey from then to now.

This is Kayode Ewumi’s story - the man behind Roll Safe.

snippet.title: Brenda Fricker Life Timeline (1945–2026) | Home Alone 2 Pigeon Lady
snippet.description:
In this video, we follow the life timeline of Brenda Fricker - the Irish actress remembered by millions as the Pigeon Lady from Home Alone 2: Lost in New York.

Born in Dublin, Ireland, in 1945, Brenda Fricker built a long and powerful acting career across theatre, television, and film. Long before many people discovered her through Home Alone 2, she had already become one of Ireland’s most respected actresses.

Her unforgettable performance in My Left Foot brought her international recognition and an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress, making her a historic figure in Irish cinema.

But for a whole generation, Brenda Fricker became beloved as the kind and lonely Pigeon Lady who helped Kevin McCallister in Home Alone 2. That role turned her into a Christmas movie icon and introduced her to millions of viewers around the world.

This timeline follows Brenda Fricker’s journey from Dublin to Oscar success, from serious drama to a beloved holiday classic, and to the legacy she left behind in 2026.
